Chapter 988: Chapter 6 The True Appearance of the Mysterious Gourd (Please Subscribe)

[Your understanding transcends the heavens, feeling different dimensions and different time-space facets, greatly enhancing your comprehension of time-space…]

…

Lin Yuan immersed himself in the temporal and spatial fluctuations around him, each thread of fluctuation in his eyes was perfect, distinctly different from the fluctuations of the Chaos Void, yet existing on the same level.

In just half a day, Lin Yuan’s comprehension of the Seventh Realm of time and space elevated from the initial stage to the middle stage.

“This is too exaggerated.”

Lin Yuan steadied his spirit, his mind extremely delighted.

For ordinary sovereign beings to advance from the initial to the middle stage of the Seventh Realm, it would take at least several cosmic eras, if not dozens.

Even for Lin Yuan, who possesses Against-Heaven’s Understanding, after entering the twelfth phase and seeing a surge in his speed of comprehension, he thought it would take thousands of years to achieve.

This was already considered extremely fast, a thousand years in the cosmos is just a few years passing in the Chaos Void.

But now.

It only took half a day?

“No wonder those beings of the thirteenth dimension of time long to explore other dimensional worlds,” thought Lin Yuan.

The faces revealed by the rules between different dimensional worlds may differ, and the different facets of these rules play a crucial role in elevating one’s own rules comprehension to perfect levels.

What is the difference between temporal beings and Perfect Time Beings?

Perfection.

Every aspect of a Perfect Time Being is perfect.

The rules they comprehend, their physical bodies and souls, all embody perfection and encompass everything.

The many dimension worlds Lin Yuan had arrived at through his numerous journeys, all fell below the dimensional plane of the Main Universe.

Even the Immortal Realm was barely on the same level as the Main Universe, but still far inferior to the Chaos Void.

If the planes were not on the level of the Main Universe and Chaos Void, the aspects of the rules they operate under are naturally mostly encompassed by the rules of the Chaos Void.

But this Origin World?

In terms of the speed of time flow, it is not inferior to the Chaos Void, and the aspects of its operating rules are even in different directions compared to those of the Chaos Void.

And the operation of rules in different directions creates an unprecedented impact for someone like Lin Yuan, who possesses Against-Heaven’s Understanding.

“This is wondrous.”

“So this is what the Golden Rule is like? Not merely symbolizing sharpness?”

“And the Water Rule? It also has an extremely destructive side?”

Lin Yuan was mesmerized, the operation of the rules in this Origin World represents a completely different path of cultivation.

Not just another way, but another grand pathway of cultivation, wholly different from the path in the Main Universe’s Chaos Void.

It’s like having the same mathematical problem and seeing different solutions, which has an unimaginable impact on understanding the essence of the problem.

…

Focusing most of his mind on comprehending the Origin Rules of this Origin World, Lin Yuan began to scrutinize himself.

[Name: Yu Yan (Lin Yuan)]

[Identity: Holder of the Myriad Realms Gate]

[Binded Talent: Against-Heaven’s Understanding]

[Divine Skills: Blood Rebirth]

[Divine Skills: Mountain Moving]

[Divine Skills: Strengthening]

[Divine Skills: Element Body]

[Divine Skills: World]

[Divine Skills: Sky Ripping]

[Current Status: Consciousness Arrival]

[Remaining Duration of Stay: None]

…

“The duration of stay is ‘none’?”

“Does this mean there’s no limit to my stay in this world? Until death or choosing to return voluntarily?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

“Also, this arrival, having split off almost half of my real True Spirit Consciousness, does this body of mine now strictly no longer count as an incarnation but rather a clone?”

Lin Yuan speculated in his mind.

With so much True Spirit Consciousness, even if Lin Yuan’s true body in the Main Universe’s Chaos Void perished, he would not die, essentially there is no difference from his true self now.

“Another boost to my survival means.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly, the true terror of the Myriad Realms Gate after the twelfth phase had just begun to show.

“What I need to do now is continue perfecting my Martial Tao path according to the operation of this Origin World’s rules,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

As the rules of different dimensional worlds vary, showing different aspects, Martial Tao naturally also needs to adapt to different extents.

And when Martial Tao reaches the stage where it can exert full strength in any dimensional world, that will be Lin Yuan’s moment stepping into the realm of Perfect Time Beings.

The path of Perfect Time Beings is universal across the Myriad Worlds and Endless Dimensional Planes, requiring no adaptation, no perfecting, because they are inherently the most perfect.

“I wonder, what Divine Skills will this physical body awaken to?” Lin Yuan anticipated inwardly.

Consolidating Bloodline Power to birth Physical Body Divine Abilities is a unique advantage of the Martial Tao Cultivation System. From the several awakenings of Physical Body Divine Abilities before, Lin Yuan concluded:

The strength of the Physical Body Divine Abilities is related

During this traversal, Lin Yuan’s residence time in the Fang Yuan World was not limited; he had plenty of time to expend.

…

Dongyang Family.

Dongyang Meng stood there quietly, her appearance strikingly beautiful.

“That Yu Family boy truly has a large fate; he even withstood our clan’s Black Descent Power.” The patriarch of the Dongyang Clan frowned from his throne.

After Dongyang Meng lured out Yu Yan, the main powerhouses of the Dongyang Clan didn’t make a move to avoid alarming the Yu Family. Instead, they utilized the Black Descent Power crafted by an ancestor of the Dongyang Family and struck Yu Yan with it.

The Black Descent Power, an ultimate destructive force, meant that even with the protection of various Yu Family assets, Yu Yan should not have been able to endure for long. Yet, he actually managed to survive until reaching his family.

“However, even though he has survived, he will need decades to recover. Next, the disciple spot for Lord Qingfen can only belong to our Dongyang Family ”

A smile emerged on the face of the patriarch of the Dongyang Clan.

As long as Dongyang Meng can become a disciple under Lord Qingfen, the Dongyang Family will ascend to great heights, becoming a top-tier family.

At that time, the Yu Family, originally a formidable foe, will no longer have the qualifications to challenge the Dongyang Family.

“Meng’er, you need not feel guilty about that Yu Family boy. You and he are not of the same level,” said the patriarch of the Dongyang Clan, comforting Dongyang Meng.

“As long as I can become a disciple of Lord Qingfen, any sacrifice is worth it,” said Dongyang Meng softly.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan summoned the six-armed figure.

“Master.” The six-armed figure was extremely respectful.

Since Lin Yuan stepped into the Twelfth Layer, revealing many of his formidable capabilities, the six-armed figure had come to regard Lin Yuan as the next Xuanhuang.

“If this universe faces a great destruction, how many lives can the Xuanhuang Secret Realm sustain?” Lin Yuan inquired.

In the face of a great cosmic destruction, multiple preparations are needed. The strongest beings of human civilization, carrying a portion of their population, and the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, can also sustain a part of the population.

“How many lives?”

The six-armed figure hesitated.

“If it’s life beneath the Twelfth Layer, at most it can sustain one hundred billion,” said the six-armed figure in a low voice.

After the great cosmic destruction, everything will revert to the initial state of chaos, and the Xuanhuang Secret Realm will shrink rapidly, with a capacity of one hundred billion lives being the limit.

“What about the Twelfth Layer?”

Lin Yuan continued to inquire.

“For the Twelfth Layer, at most ten,” the six-armed figure reported truthfully.

Every Twelfth Layer being is under the critical watch of the cosmic Origin Consciousness. The loss of one or two Twelfth Layer beings is manageable, but more than ten? The Xuanhuang Secret Realm might even become the target of the cosmic Origin.

The methods of Xuanhuang are unfathomable; with a wave of his hand, he created thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Xuanhuang Secret Realms, integrating them into different universes.

But after all, they are merely integrated, not the universe itself.

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded, acknowledging that the Xuanhuang Secret Realm could completely serve as humanity’s fallback.

At worst, they could become the second Robber Clan, enduring until the next Cosmic Era, as long as the lineage of human civilization continues.

Of course, even after the great cosmic destruction, Lin Yuan would leave behind a willful incarnation in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, both as a means to control this realm and as his own life-saving resource.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm isolates causal spacetime, and being inside the universe, its safety level is only slightly lower than the Origin World.

“Another thing.”

Lin Yuan suddenly stated.

“Please speak, Master,” immediately responded the six-armed figure.

“Do you recognize this golden box?” An image of the golden box purchased at the Thousand Treasures Convention appeared before Lin Yuan, bearing the unique mark of the Profound Xuanhuang.

“This is?”

The six-armed figure examined the golden box carefully; with its expression continuously changing, it spoke, “It’s a treasure of our Profound Xuanhuang lineage. Each of these boxes has been personally crafted by His Majesty Xuanhuang, each containing relics crucial to the lineage of Profound Xuanhuang.”

“Personally crafted by His Majesty Xuanhuang?”

Lin Yuan’s expression turned solemn, the origin of this golden box being even more significant than he had thought.

Initially, it was regarded as a precious treasure of the Profound Xuanhuang lineage, but personally crafted by His Majesty Xuanhuang? What stature does His Majesty Xuanhuang hold? Could the box he personally crafted be a simple object?

Even the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was merely an incidental creation by His Majesty Xuanhuang, crafting over thirty thousand in one go.

“How can it be opened?” Lin Yuan asked.

“I am not sure,” the six-armed figure shook its head, “Master, you only need to probe with the aura of your Xuanhuang mark. As long as it meets the requirements to open, the box will naturally open.”

Lin Yuan, having taken charge of a Xuanhuang Secret Realm, held the identity of a successor of His Majesty Xuanhuang—an identity that could be confirmed by the Xuanhuang mark within him.

…

Having acquired the desired answers from the six-armed figure.

Lin Yuan was about to continue his cultivation and enlightenment. The rules operating in different facets of the Origin World brought profound impacts to Lin Yuan, with new insights emerging nearly every moment.

“Hmm?”

Just then, Lin Yuan’s expression subtly changed.

“A gourd?”

Lin Yuan extended his right hand, and a palm-sized gourd appeared.

Since Lin Yuan ascended to the Twelfth Layer, his internal world transformed into an internal universe, and this mysterious gourd began a kind of transformation, which was now nearly complete.

“This is?”

Lin Yuan held the gourd.

A massive amount of information surged from within the gourd into his mind.
